message: **`GET /v1/models` no longer advertises a surface the gateway refuses.** The per-model `capabilities` array was derived from the provider catalog's `supports_chat`, `supports_embeddings`, and `supports_streaming` booleans in `crates/sbproxy-ai/data/ai_providers.yml`, while the request path decided its 501 from the per-provider surface matrix in `crates/sbproxy-ai/src/api_routes.rs`. The two disagreed on 43 of the 72 shipped catalog entries, in both directions: a `bedrock` origin advertised `embeddings` on its own listing and then answered `POST /v1/embeddings` with 501, and a `vertex` origin hid an embeddings surface it does serve. Every model listing now reads the matrix, so a caller can act on what the listing names. Two changes are visible on the wire. The vocabulary widens past `chat_completions` / `embeddings` / `streaming` to every model-addressable surface the provider handles, so an OpenAI-format provider also lists `reranking`, `image_generation`, `audio_transcription`, and the rest; account-scoped surfaces such as `files` and `batches` are not per-model facts and stay out. And the LiteLLM-parity `GET /model/info` and `GET /model_group/info` now carry the same `capabilities` array, a group reporting the union across its deployments. The three catalog booleans remain in `ai_providers.yml` as notes about the vendor's API, read by nothing; see [docs/providers.md](docs/providers.md) and the model-listing section of [docs/ai-gateway.md](docs/ai-gateway.md).
